review_method: Root逐音视读完整适用公开乐谱，逐项对照现有来源及编配时值。 所有正式ScoreCodec事件均与已审时间线比较；隔离导入和重启校验通过，软件虚拟播放未发送真实输入。人工听感未验证，真实游戏未测试。
review_note: complete-44-bar-piano-source;all-original-attacks-and-on-off-events-explicitly-disposed Complete 44-bar selected piano edition: intro, verses, choruses, instrumental transitions and outro retained. No vocal-only template or source truncation. Printed 100 BPM is authority for this edition; MIDI91/EOP88 metadata is not treated as original-performance evidence. Every one of 729 source notes and 1458 raw on/off events is individually disposed, including accompaniment, inner chords and ornaments; every all-voice silent interval is listed. Every output note selects an actual source pitch before explicit register adaptation. No added attacks, pitch-class repairs or merged separate source attacks. Printed ties extend one selected attack across all reference segments. Full score opening 3.5beat rest retained; only explicit EOP file offset removed: 0 beats under original header tempo. Source MIDI has no extra offset. Source short note gates and performance/arpeggiation timing are replaced by the selected written voice rhythm. All onset and duration deltas are recorded individually. Printed top melodic voice for bars1-41, with m8 descending lower-register instrumental fill; m42-44 sole active left-hand outro. Select one chord tone only; these are intentional arrangement reductions. After source alignment, magnified original page3 row2 again: two upper octave dots in m39 and m41 were missed by first full-page view. m40 beat0.75 highest printed E6, not C6 inner chord tone. Corrected from original image; source corroborates these notes. v1 retained. All other 44-bar reading values retained. m10/m18 final three small regular-size written triplet notes have three duration beams: each 1/12 beat. These are not small grace notes and are retained at the printed rhythm; source EOP/MIDI placements differ. m16 small G5 grace omitted while regular A5 principal note retained. Lower chord tones and left-hand accompaniment omitted whenever selected right-hand melody/printed right-hand rest is active. m35 internal lower-chord voice sixteenth rests do not interrupt top-voice ties. No rhythmic simplification of printed m10/m18 triplets; source timing is corrected to the actual printed triplet grid. Use10ms practice release gap; human_listening not-performed; real_game not-tested. 1487 m10/m18: three actual duration beams under regular notes, hence each triplet is1/12 quarter beat; source numbers do not establish printed duration. 1487 m39/41 two upper dots and m40 second chord upperE6 confirmed from enlarged page3. m35 inner-voice interruptions do not break upper tie. 1487 entire m42-44 left-hand outro selected; lowest printedG#2 raised toG#3. Last D4 tie lasts6.5 beats and becomesD5. 14714 m42 triplet group has two beams, each1/6 beat; m80 two D5 attacks remain distinct. m95 first half beat continues priorC5, then a newC5 3.5beats. 14714 m102 last left-hand octave topC3 sustained4beats, not clipped with right-hand rests. Earlier candidate performance/arpeggiation language is treated only as numeric source onset/gate variation; no human performance or recording alignment established. Root逐页核对完整八页、146小节，明确非盲复核；直接绝对音高重点数组另外保存。全部原始音、on/off、全声部静音区间及所有输出事件重新验算。 两份早期版完整44小节采用印刷100BPM与分段八度适配；完整版102小节采用印刷88BPM、无需移调。所有伴奏/下方和弦音/小倚音省略逐项透明保存，不称原谱错误。
